name: NiSource
outlook:
What NiSource says to expect

  • 2026 and 2027: adjusted EPSNiSource is narrowing its 2026 non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance to the upper half of $2.02-$2.07. In 2027, non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS is expected to be in the range of $2.22-$2.30.
  • 2027 to 2033: capital plan and EPS growthThe new consolidated seven-year total capital expenditures of $40.0 billion are expected to support 9%-10% consolidated investment base growth from 2027-2033 and an expected consolidated non-GAAP adjusted EPS compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10%-11% for 2027-2033.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
